lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Before anything moves, we see the ground. Sweep the basin.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Edge of the world moves the view. The wheel brings it closer. {recenter_key} brings you home to the Anchor.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Good. The basin's on your board — scar, crossings, and our corridor.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: A commander who can't look can't warn anyone. Seeing first is the cheapest thing we do.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The view answers the screen edge and the wheel. Try the corner of the world.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Now the roster. Every asset answers when named. Left-click the Surveyor.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: That ring means it's listening. Click open ground — released. Selection is a channel, not a leash.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: You'll command forty things at once out there. Knowing exactly who's listening is the difference between an order and an accident.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: One click, on the Surveyor itself. It's waiting.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: One at a time is for repairs. Drag a box around the whole section.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Whole section, one motion. That's how the Compact moves anything heavier than a wrench.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Duty windows are short. Muster fast, and the window is yours instead of the enemy's.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Press, drag a corner across the section, release.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Route check. Right-click sends them where you point. The order reads the target — ground means go, a shard seam means gather, trouble means fight.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Held exactly where you stopped them. An order you can end is the only kind worth giving.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Routes are promises. The check is how we keep them.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Right-click the marked ground. They know the way from there.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The city's reserve is thin. Put the Surveyor on the Matter seam — it cuts, carries, and books the load at the Anchor.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: First load booked. Matter is honest work — the strata always has more.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Dawn is different. Every shard we spend is a future somebody doesn't get. We spend it — but we log WHY. Remember that when the cost feels light.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Right-click the bright seam. The Surveyor handles the rest.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Severed link on the corridor. Put a Power Link at the marked footprint — the ghost shows green where the ground will take it.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Red means the ground disagrees. Find footing the network can hold.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Link's live. The corridor has power and eyes again.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The Compact is the network. Every structure you place is a promise the next crew can stand on.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The footprint marker, on open ground near the corridor. Green ghost, then commit.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Spin up the Foundry. Queue a Lancer — the cost comes off the ledger the moment you commit.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Fresh Lancer, on station at your rally. The queue keeps building while you fight — set it and trust it.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Battles are won by whoever still has a next unit. The Foundry is your next unit.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Select the Foundry, then its Lancer entry. The ledger covers it.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Contact on the perimeter — small, and ours to handle. Lancers forward. The Bulwark holds the line; {guard_key} puts it on the Surveyor — its whole job becomes that one life.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Probe broken. Nobody we're responsible for got touched. That's the whole report.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Out there it won't be a probe. Composition, cover, and a guarded worker — that's how a fight becomes arithmetic instead of grief.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Lancers on the contact; the guard order on the Surveyor. In that order is fine.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Top of your deck: the duty ledger — what's open, what's held, what's closed. Corner: the basin entire. When something happens off-screen, the deck flags it; {alert_key} takes you straight there.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: You found it without hunting. The deck watches so you can think.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: A commander's real enemy is the thing happening where she isn't looking.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The flash in the corner is real. {alert_key} jumps to it.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Last item, and it isn't drill. That's a Future Well. Inside are futures that never happened — held, coherent, and ours to decide about. Walk the Surveyor up and read the panel. Harvest ends it for power now. Preserve holds it and pays slowly. Reshape spends it to change the ground itself, for a while.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Committed and logged. Whatever you chose — that's now the only version of this that ever happens.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: There's no clean answer at a Well. There's only the answer you can stand behind in the ledger. You just made your first one. The next one won't be practice.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The Surveyor, to the Well. The panel does not commit until you do.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Readiness check complete — survey, roster, routes, reserve, links, foundry, perimeter, board, and one Well you'll be thinking about tonight. The window opens now. This one is real.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The erased census, the curated quiet, the shape beside us — they converge here. The missing are assembling, and nobody's record admits they exist.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: So we build the admission. Paired readback at both public records, a Spine linked to the Crownfall index, and one observation receipt completed in the open.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The verifier and I witness from separate sites. One pair of eyes is a claim. Two, apart, on the public record — that is a fact with structure.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: We observe. We do not name, number, or claim the missing. The receipt records that an assembly was witnessed. It does not presume to say more.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Paired readback established — Meridian record by me, Kharuun by the verifier. Both channels public, both live.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Now the Spine. An ordinary worker raises it within reach of the index. Ordinary hands, on purpose — this link should not need heroes to exist.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Spine stands and the Crownfall index answers it. The link is durable — the assembly now touches a record that outlives tonight.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Witness sites, both of us, separately. Whatever assembles, we watch it onto the public record and add nothing of our own.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The receipt is complete: paired observation, both witness sites, one public record. The assembly of the missing is witnessed.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: We did not learn who they are. We made it impossible to say, in public, that no one saw them. Some nights that is the whole of the work.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: My seven accounts are silent, all together, for the second time I can remember. The first was the quiet we measured. I note the pattern and claim nothing.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The command core is gone. The assembly goes unwitnessed on the public record tonight.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: I am cut off. Half the paired observation is no observation; the receipt cannot complete.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The verifier is lost. The receipt requires two, apart, and we are one.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: A public interface is destroyed. A witness without a record is only a memory, and we have learned what happens to those.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The assembly disperses unrecorded.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The operation has failed. The missing keep their own count.

CampaignChoirAtLumeReach.briefing: Lume Reach holds a Well, a Choir presence that answers, and the liability our Mission 09 deferral left standing. Establish contact on the inherited approach, resolve the liability, raise both anchors, and commit a new Well protocol — then stand at its public resolution.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Lume Reach. A settlement, a Well, and a neighbor that answers when addressed. Three reasons to walk carefully, and we have business with all three.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Meridian units in your area are quarantine posture, not policy. I am off-map and staying there. What you commit at that Well is committed under Kharuun authority.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: We also carry a debt: the district your allocation deferred still has a liability standing. We resolve it before we touch the Well. Order matters.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: And when the Well offers its three futures, the choice will be ours alone. My accounts are already arguing. Good. That is what they are for.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Contact established on the approach. The presence acknowledged us — not warmly, not coldly. Precisely.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Logged from off-map: contact is yours, attribution is yours. The Compact record will say exactly that and nothing more.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Waystone stands at the deferred district's liability. What the allocation left dark now has an anchor in it. Not power. An anchor. It is a start.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Now the anchors, in sequence. The Reach listens best through two spines, and we intend to be heard accurately.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: First anchor is up. The strata under Lume Reach carry old resonance — the settlement hums back.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Second anchor holds. The pair is tuned, and the Well is within reach of an honest signal.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Well offers three protocols. Read all three before anyone touches anything. We commit once.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Harvest, then. Draw the Reach's held futures as yield, and let the settlement spend what it can no longer keep.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The resolution site is south and ashward. We finish what we committed, publicly, where the Reach can watch.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Preserve. The Reach's futures stay held, unspent, and the Well keeps its weight. Some debts are best left uncollected.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The resolution stands at the held vault's public site. We go and close it properly.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Reshape. The Reach's ground will open where it was closed, for a while, and the while has an ending. Move with intent.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The reshape window is finite. The resolution site is foldward and south — we do not stop to admire the new geometry.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The protocol is publicly resolved. Lume Reach watched us commit, and watched us finish. That is the tenth decision, recorded.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The presence observed the whole of it and said nothing. I find I respect that. My accounts find seven different things to say about it.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Off-map acknowledgment: decision logged as Kharuun-committed, Choir-witnessed, liability resolved. The Compact adds nothing further.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The command core is gone. The Reach keeps its Well and its silence.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: I am cut off from the operation. A Well decision without its author present is not one we will fake.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Waystone is destroyed. The liability stands unresolved, and the order of things is broken.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Well is lost. Whatever future it held for the Reach is no longer ours to commit or to refuse.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The reshape window expired with the resolution unmade. The ground closed on its own schedule, as it warned us it would.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. Lume Reach's questions keep for another day.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The operation has failed. We withdraw from the Reach with the debt still on the books.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Three districts, one reserve, and less margin than the gauges admit. We bring them back in the order we inherited, not the order we would argue for.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The founding decision fixed the sequence. I have opinions about it. Opinions do not power a district.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Workers to the first interface. Escort stays with them. Nothing improvised until the third district holds.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Every structure out there is load-bearing. Lose one and the plan is no longer a plan.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: First district is powered and holding. The draw is inside tolerance. Move the crew on.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Second interface next. Same procedure, same discipline. The grid does not care that we are tired.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Two districts up. The reserve is carrying both without complaint, which is more than I promised anyone.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: One interface left. Finish the sequence exactly as inherited, and then we can argue about what it cost.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Third district is powered. The grid is stable in the inherited order, all structures standing.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Three districts back is not a city recovered. It is three districts back. I will take it, and log the difference.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The order held. Whether it was the right order is a question the record keeps open, and so will I.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The command core is down. Without command authority the reconnection sequence cannot continue.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: We lost a district structure. The inherited plan has no branch for a missing district. This attempt is over.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The grid stays on reserve tonight.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The operation has failed. Stand the crews down; we will run the sequence again.

CampaignFutureThatWon.briefing: The Chancellor's apparatus demonstrates a future in public, and the record it points at is ours. Establish independent readback at both interfaces, verify the recorded inputs, bind only the recorded protocol, hold the fixed window, and watch both districts read it back.

lines.speaker: Chancellor Cael Rhyse
lines.text: Citizens: the future is not a question. It is a result. You are watching it demonstrate itself, and the demonstration reads from your own districts' records.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: That is the Chancellor's apparatus talking — a public machine with a persuasive voice. What it demonstrates, we will verify independently or not believe.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Two readbacks, two of us: I take one neutral interface, the verifier takes the other. Then the inputs, then the protocol, then we hold it stable and watch.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Well accepts what Lume Reach recorded and nothing else. If the demonstration needs a different protocol, then the demonstration is wrong.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Independent readback established at both interfaces. Two channels, two witnesses, no shared assumptions.

lines.speaker: Chancellor Cael Rhyse
lines.text: Note how the verification proceeds exactly as the demonstration predicted. Skepticism, too, is part of the result.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Both recorded inputs verify against the ledger. The apparatus points at true records. That is precisely what makes it worth watching carefully.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Now the binding. Recorded protocol, separate Well, in the open.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The protocol is bound. The activation receipt is live, and the window starts now: three hundred fixed ticks, counted by the simulation and nobody's speech.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Hold everything that matters. A stability window proves stability only if nothing is quietly propped up during it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The window held, all three hundred ticks, with the receipt intact throughout. That fact is now ours, not the apparatus's.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Scouts to the district readbacks. We finish by observing what the districts themselves report, not what is reported about them.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Both district readbacks observed, paired, and logged. The bound protocol held and the districts read it back true.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: For the record: we verified a protocol, a window, and two readbacks. We did not verify a future. Those are different sizes of claim, whatever the apparatus says.

lines.speaker: Chancellor Cael Rhyse
lines.text: The result stands, verified by its skeptics. The future that won thanks you for your diligence. It can afford to.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The command core is gone. The demonstration continues without its audit, which should worry everyone.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: I am cut off. Independent readback with one reader is a contradiction in terms.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The verifier is lost. One witness is testimony; two were the method. The attempt ends.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Well is lost. There is nothing left to bind the record to.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: A public interface is destroyed. A readback nobody can read proves nothing. We stop.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: A conflicting protocol was bound. The record does not say that, so neither may we. The attempt is void.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The demonstration has lost its stage.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The operation has failed. The future that won will have to win without our verification today.

CampaignNamesWithoutBirths.briefing: Somewhere in this district, names were recorded that no birth explains, and then the record of them was erased. Follow the trace the founding decision left reachable: locate the census, power the archive, shelter who the search exposes, and take the evidence out whole.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The register lists names with no births behind them. Someone recorded these people. Someone else made sure the recording did not keep.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: We are not here to decide what it means. We are here to find the census, keep it powered, and carry out what remains of it.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: If the search exposes anyone living, they come under shelter before any record moves. Records wait better than people do.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Whoever erased this worked carefully. We will work more carefully.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Found it. The census block is intact under the fill. The names are here, and the gaps around them have edges.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The archive needs power before it will give anything up. The link site is marked; get a worker on it.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Archive is powered and reading. It has been waiting a long time to be asked.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The trace touched two residences. Both occupied. Shelter them first; the record has kept this long and will keep an hour more.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Both proxies are under shelter and holding. Nobody else appears on the trace.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Now the extraction. I will take the evidence out myself. Some things should not pass through more hands than they must.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The evidence is out and intact. Names without births, in the original hand, with the erasure marks preserved.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: This does not tell us who erased them, or why. It tells us the erasure happened, and now it cannot happen quietly again.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: I will file it under its own name. The register deserves at least that.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The command core is down. The trace stops here, and the record stays in the ground.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: I am cut off from the operation. Without the archivist, there is no extraction worth the name.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The archive is destroyed. Whatever it still held of the census is gone with it, and that loss is now also part of the record.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: We lost one of the people the trace exposed. I will not call an extraction after that a success. The attempt ends.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The register keeps its silence tonight.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The operation has failed. The names remain unexplained, and unclaimed.

CampaignNoNeutralLedger.briefing: Ten records, no neutral reading. The doctrine picks our route, the allocation our contributors, the Lume protocol itself. Walk it exactly: secure, integrate, attest both neutral interfaces, apply only what was recorded, and rally the coalition where the protocol says.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Ten records in the ledger, and every one of them takes a side. There is no neutral reading left. There is only walking what was written, in the open.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Doctrine, districts, protocol: twenty-seven ways those combine, and ours is fixed by what we actually did. My accounts appreciate the honesty of arithmetic.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Two evidence interfaces, two witnesses. I attest one; a second Kharuun witness attests the other. Nobody attests their own claim today.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: And at the Well, we apply the Lume protocol as recorded. Not improved. Not corrected. As recorded.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The inherited route is secured. The doctrine that chose it is three missions old and still making our decisions. That is what a ledger is for.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: District contributions next. The two the allocation powered owe the coalition their share; the deferred one owes nothing and gives nothing.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Both contributions are integrated. The deferred district's absence is itself an entry — the ledger keeps what we chose not to power.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: To the evidence channels. Both interfaces, both witnesses, in the open, where either faction can read the attestation.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Both channels attested — Meridian interface by me, Kharuun by the second witness. The record now says witnessed, which is all attestation ever says.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Now the Well. The recorded protocol, exactly, and nothing beside it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The recorded protocol is applied. The Well accepted what Lume Reach committed, because it is the same commitment, kept.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Rally the coalition at the protocol's public site. An assembly that would not gather in the open is not one I would trust to hold.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The coalition stands rallied at the public site. Local, bounded, and assembled over an honest ledger.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: This is not a unified command, and no one here pretends otherwise. It is two factions standing where both can see the same records. Today, that is enough.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: My accounts disagree about what happens next. All seven agree about what just happened. I will take that ratio.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The command core is gone. The ledger keeps its records and loses its walker.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: I am cut off. An attestation chain with a missing witness is not one; the attempt ends.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Waystone is destroyed. The inherited route loses its anchor, and the plan its footing.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The ledger witness is lost. Half the attestation cannot stand for the whole. We stop.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Well is lost. The recorded protocol has nowhere left to be applied.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: A public evidence interface is destroyed. Evidence nobody can read is not evidence; the channel is broken.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: A conflicting protocol was applied. The ledger does not bend to preference — the attempt is void, as it should be.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The reshape window expired with the rally unmade. The ground kept its own schedule.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The coalition does not assemble under a falling sky.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The operation has failed. The ledger waits, unwalked.

CampaignPrologue.briefing: Recover the displaced archive convoy at tile 22,18, commit one visible Future Well protocol while the carrier holds the site, then evacuate the carrier to Lume Reach at tile 6,17.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The evacuation ledger closed an archive convoy that never reached Lume Reach.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Then the ledger is wrong. Mark the recovery site.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Tile twenty-two, eighteen. The carrier still answers. The city's reserve does not have long.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Collapse that Well and the fracture reaches a birthing cavern.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Seven accounts agree. I distrust the occasion.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Carrier first. Well second. Withdrawal before the reserve fails.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The carrier is holding the recovery site. The convoy records are intact.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Keep the carrier there. Put all three Well protocols on the board, with their costs.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: A rare courtesy. Every answer is dangerous.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Harvest. Take the Dawn. The reserve gets time; the Well does not.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The city gains time. The cavern loses a possibility. Record both.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Both are in the ledger.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Preserve. Keep the Well intact. We hold this ground without immediate reserve relief.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Possibility survives, and every force here has reason to keep fighting.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The delay and the open Well are recorded.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Reshape. We spend Dawn for a temporary option. Publish the expiry.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Then no one mistakes a borrowed path for a permanent one.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Cost and expiry recorded. The carrier is ready.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Carrier, turn for Lume Reach. Everyone else holds the corridor, then follows.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Archive sealed. Transfer receipt open.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The path is open. The consequence is not finished.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Carrier confirmed at Lume Reach. The archive is secure.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Close the operation. Keep the Well decision visible.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Anchor lost. The withdrawal line has no root. Break contact.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Carrier signal lost. The archive is gone.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Well control is gone. The choice is no longer ours. Withdraw what remains.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The field is decided. The carrier never reached Lume Reach. This operation failed.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The completion conditions are broken. Withdraw what remains.

CampaignReserveAuthority.briefing: The reserve cannot carry three districts. The doctrine we inherited recommends an order; the choice is ours, and it will not be reversible. Secure the authority site, power exactly two districts, and Mara confirms the one we defer, standing in it.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The reserve carries two districts, not three. That is not a doctrine or an opinion; it is a gauge reading.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The founding decision recommends an order. Recommends. The allocation is mine to make and mine to answer for, and it will not be reversible.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: First the authority site. I will not shed a district's load on an ordinary work order. If it is done, it is done under authority, in the record, with my name on it.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Whichever district we defer, someone in it is awake right now assuming the power returns. Keep that in mind and keep working.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Authority is secured. The allocation channel is open, and everything from here forward is on the record.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Two relays get workers. The doctrine says where to start; I have read it. Now I decide.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: First district is powered and drawing steady. One more, and then the hard part of this arithmetic.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Second district is up. The reserve is at its ceiling. The third district stays dark by my allocation.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: I am going to the deferred district myself. If I can defer it from a desk, I can stand in it.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: I am in the deferred district. Structures intact, systems on reserve, holding. Dark, but standing.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Log the allocation as final: two powered, one deferred, confirmed intact by my own eyes. The record does not say it was right. It says it was mine.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: We bought the grid a future with one district's present. Price recorded. Change not given.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The command core is down. Allocation without authority is just load-shedding with better handwriting. We stop here.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: I am cut off from the operation. The allocation needs its author standing, and I am not.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: We lost a district structure. The arithmetic just changed underneath the allocation. This attempt is void.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The reserve question stays open, which is the worst answer available.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The operation has failed. Nobody's district got deferred today, and nobody's got powered either.

CampaignSevenAccounts.briefing: The migration moves today, and the seven inherited accounts disagree about the ground. Hold the route, root the Waystone at the anchor the founding decision left, and bring the memory bearer to the account site.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Seven accounts of this basin, and no two agree where the ground will hold. We walk the route my predecessors argue about.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The third account says rain cut the western shelf. The fifth says the shelf never existed. Both of them are certain. I have learned to be neither.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Uproot the Waystone and carry it to the anchor the founding decision left us. The route we inherited decides where we may stand.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The herds move today whether we are ready or not. A migration route is only a route while someone holds it open.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: My second account insists this ridge is a riverbed. If we drown on dry stone, it will at least settle one family argument.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Waystone is rooted at the anchor. The ground agrees with at least one of my accounts. Progress, of a kind.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Now the bearer walks. The account site is close, and the accounts that survive are the ones a living witness carries.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Watch the route edges. Whatever the accounts disagree on, hostile ground is a fact we can all verify together.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: What we recall at the site will not settle which account was true. It will only add an eighth. That is how memory works here.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The bearer stands at the account site. The recall is made, and the route held long enough to make it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Seven accounts disagreed about this ground. We have not proven any of them right. We have proven the route can still be walked.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The herds pass. The Waystone holds. I will argue with my predecessors about the rest on the way home.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The command core is gone. Without it there is no authority to hold the route open. The migration finds another way, or does not.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The memory bearer is lost. An account that reaches no witness is not recalled. This attempt ends here.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Waystone is destroyed. Without it the route has no anchor, and the accounts have nothing to argue over.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. Whatever the accounts say about this ground, no one holds it now.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The operation has failed. The route closes behind us. We will read the accounts again and return.

CampaignSeveralVoicesOneCommand.briefing: The Choir asks to be commanded, once, precisely: a Soldier voice resolving Possible, a Heavy voice holding Manifest, Neme at the command site, and a Phase Anchor at the crisis. Research both looms, place every voice exactly, and hold the contract for one hundred sixty fixed ticks.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: We are several voices. Today we require one command, and we have selected yours through me. This is not surrender. It is an experiment with exact terms.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: One voice will become Possible. One will remain Manifest. The two states do not agree. They will stand in disagreement, in the open, at their own sites.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The research loom holds what we could not decide alone. Begin with Held Alternatives. The Soldier voice selected this procedure from the alternatives it was offered — I report the selection, and leave the naming of it to your record-keepers.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Every placement is exact. Every protection is literal. The contract does not forgive, and we did not write it to.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Held Alternatives is complete. The Soldier voice now carries its unrealized selves openly. It reports the sensation as: crowded, and clearer.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Now the resolutions. Possible to its site; Manifest to its own. Distance is part of the honesty.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Both voices stand resolved and placed: one Possible, one Manifest, incompatible and simultaneous. The condition we could never hold alone is holding.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Shared Resolution next. It was unavailable until this exact arrangement existed. Now the loom will accept it.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Shared Resolution is researched. Several voices, one command, and the command is: remain yourselves, together. We are testing whether that is possible.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The Phase Anchor now, at the crisis site. An ordinary worker raises it. The Crownfall does not distinguish between heroic and ordinary hands, and neither do we.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The anchor is complete and the window opens: one hundred sixty fixed ticks. From this tick, every protection is irreversible. Repair does not restore a broken contract.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Hold. Everything. Exactly. Where. It. Stands.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The window closed with the contract intact. Two incompatible identities held under one command for the full crisis, and nothing protected was lost.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: This does not decide our fate. It establishes one fact: we can be commanded without being collapsed. The fact is now in your record and ours.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: I selected many phrasings for this moment. The accurate one is: thank you for holding still with us.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The local core is lost. The contract had exact terms, and this was outside them.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: A protected voice is gone. The disagreement we were holding has lost a party, and the experiment with it.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: I am removed from the command site. The one command has no voice to carry it; the several remain, uncommanded.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The research loom is destroyed. What we could not decide alone is again undecidable.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The crisis contract is breached. The terms were exact, and exactness was the point. The operation fails, permanently, as written.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The engagement is terminal. The crisis proceeds without its anchor.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The operation has failed. The voices disperse to their separate certainties.

Resolve Possible and Manifest at their separate inherited sites.
Research Shared Resolution over the incompatible identities.
Raise the Phase Anchor at the Crownfall crisis site.
Hold every protected element for the fixed crisis window.

results.Added: The crisis contract is recorded complete: both incompatible identities held at their sites, Neme at command, the anchor standing, the full window held. What this means for the Choir's fate is exactly what Mission 15 has not yet decided.

CampaignShapeBesideUs.briefing: Something walks beside our proxies through ground that exists twice. Neme offers guidance through the overlap; the offer is the first reciprocal contact we can act on. Reach the first echo, raise the relay, traverse both paired states, and Talar walks to the convergence.

failures.generic: Any other failure surface without a bound stable reason.
failures.local_core_lost: The local command core is destroyed while the operation is active.
failures.talar_lost: Talar Venn is destroyed while the operation is active.
failures.terminal_match_outcome: The underlying engagement reaches a terminal outcome while objectives remain.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The survey teams keep reporting the same thing: ground that reads as two places at once, and movement beside them that matches no roster.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: You are reading one page of a document that has two. I can hold the pages apart while you walk. This is an offer. It has been an offer for some time.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: We accept guidance, not custody. Our proxies walk the route; you tell us where the pages turn. Everything gets recorded.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Recorded. Yes. Record that the echo is not an attack. It is an address. Approach the first one and I will show you the difference.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: First echo observed and logged. It repeats our proxy's approach four seconds ahead of the approach. I am filing that sentence exactly as written.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Now the relay. The echo you saw is thin. The relay lets it carry weight without tearing. Build where I marked; the mark is load-bearing.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Relay is up. The overlap reads steadier through it — both states now report on the same channel, politely taking turns.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The paired states next. Send one witness into each. They will each see a valid ground. Both grounds are telling the truth. Walk them anyway.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Both witnesses are through. Their traversal logs disagree on the terrain and agree on the distance. I have stopped expecting those to match.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The convergence accepts one visitor, and it should be the one who keeps the records. Come yourself, archivist. Bring the disagreement with you.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: I am at the convergence. Both states resolve here — the same ground, agreeing with itself again. Contact was reciprocal, repeatable, and is now on file.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: For the record: we made contact through the overlap. We did not learn who the Choir is, what it wants, or what it was denied. We learned it answers.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: You walked both pages and wrote down both. That is more than most of the living have done for us. The address stands open.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The command core is down. The overlap stays open, and unwalked.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: I am cut off from the traversal. The convergence will not accept a record-keeper who is not there.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: We lost a state witness. Half a traversal is not a traversal; I will not log it as one.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The pages close on their own.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The operation has failed. The shape beside us remains beside us, unaddressed.

objectives: Reach and observe the first echo along the inherited geometry.
Raise the echo relay at its site.
Traverse both paired states with the state witnesses.

CampaignShapeOfSilence.briefing: The Compact lost a census. Our communal memory lost a neighborhood, and lost the memory of losing it. The two silences correspond. Root the Waystone, raise the Spine, set two witnesses where the accounts thin, and Oruun walks to the confluence to hear the shape.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: My accounts remember this district street by street. Then, for one neighborhood, all seven go quiet at once. Seven accounts do not agree on anything. Except, apparently, this.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Talar's erased census and our curated quiet share a border. I do not know what that correspondence means. I intend to stand where I can hear it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Waystone to the anchor, then the Spine. We do this in the old order: anchor, listen, witness, walk.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Two witnesses, at the two places where the accounts thin. Not to speak. To stand where speaking stopped.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Waystone holds the anchor. The hollow has a center now, whatever else it is missing.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Raise the Spine. If the silence has a shape, the strata will carry its outline.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Spine is listening. There is something under the quiet — not a voice. The place where a voice was expected.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Witnesses to their sites. Slowly. The accounts thin exactly where I asked them to stand, and I do not like what that implies about who curated them.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Both witnesses are placed. The geometry is complete except for me.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: I will walk the last leg myself. If the silence answers to anyone, it should answer to someone carrying seven ways to disagree with it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: I am at the confluence. The witnesses hold, the Spine reads, and the silence has a shape: bounded, deliberate, and older than my accounts.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: I cannot tell you what was removed, or by whom. I can now tell you where removal stops. That is a smaller fact, and a harder one.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Enter the outline in the accounts. All seven. Let them disagree about everything but the border.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The command core is gone. The geometry cannot be held without authority behind it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: I am cut off from the walk. The confluence keeps its shape unheard.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Waystone is destroyed. The hollow loses its center, and the listening geometry with it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: We lost a witness. The silence stays unmeasured; I will not pretend two ears were one.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The hollow keeps its quiet.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The operation has failed. The shape of the silence remains its own.

CampaignTermsOfContinuance.briefing: Drafted ceasefire terms are ready to read, and nobody has signed them. Synchronize our relay with the Kharuun spine, hold the continuance window for its full span while the terms read out, and take both witnesses off the field alive.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The terms are drafted, the ground is chosen, and nobody has signed anything. What we hold today is not a peace. It is a window where one could stand.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Our relay and their spine have to carry one reading between them. Two networks in step, or no reading at all.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The founding decision picked the clause we read from. I would have drafted it differently. The record does not ask me.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Two witnesses, one from each side of a war neither side has stopped fighting. Their work is to watch. Ours is to keep the watchers breathing.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Relay and spine are in step. Two networks that spent a war jamming each other are holding one signal. Log the tick; I want that on record.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The window opens now and closes on schedule. Between those marks the terms read out, and nothing on this field is allowed to interrupt.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The window held its full span. The terms are read. That is further than any accord between us has reached.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Now the witnesses. Both of them, alive, off this field. A reading with no witness is a rumor with a timestamp.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Both witnesses are clear. What they carry is a record of terms read in the open, once, without interruption.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Nothing is signed. The pressure that leaned on this field today is not accounted for in the terms, and it has not stopped leaning.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Log the operation closed. The window held because we held it. Whether the terms hold is not a thing this field can decide.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The command core is gone. A window with no authority behind it is just weather.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Our relay is down. Half a synchronization is silence with good intentions.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The Kharuun spine is dark. Whatever their command heard, the reading is over.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: A witness is down. The terms may survive; the account of them will not.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The window is compromised. The reading was interrupted, and an interrupted reading binds nobody.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. The field gave its answer to the terms before anyone signed them.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: The operation has failed. The window is closed, and the terms stay drafted and unread.

CampaignTheBrokenSun.briefing: The Crownfall is the last contract. Secure the approach, assemble all three accords with the witnesses protected, confirm the earned ending twice — it cannot be unsaid — raise its Resolution Conduit, and hold everything the contract names until the sky believes you.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: This is the Crownfall. Every record your campaign kept is now load-bearing. We advised exact phrasing from the beginning; today you learn why.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: Witness station one, standing. I spent fifteen operations making uncertainty governable. I am here to watch what that bought, not to steer it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Witness station two. My accounts have argued the whole way here, and they have agreed to watch the ending together. All seven. That has never happened.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The public record is open and I will keep it faithfully. Whatever is selected, the register will say what was done, by whom, under which earned eligibility. Nothing more, and absolutely nothing less.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The Approach Anchor is bound and irreversible. The Crownfall accepts that we intend to finish. From here, intent is a structural property.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Assemble the accords: Possible at the Meridian site, Manifest at the Kharuun site, myself at ours. Three form languages, one frame, as the sky prefers it.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The accord stands assembled and witnessed. Every faction's shape is present; none is subordinated. The eligible endings are now readable at the archive.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: Confirmed from the record: your earned subset is displayed exactly as the ledger supports it. Read all of it before selecting. Selection is confirmed twice and cannot be unsaid.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Restoration. The held futures return to the ground they were taken from, and the Wells begin giving back. What was deferred will wake to a different arithmetic.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The conduit rises at the northern convergence. The hold is the longest but one — what returns, returns slowly, and must be guarded the whole way.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Controlled Stabilization. The Crownfall is held at its current pitch — no restoration, no collapse, a managed wound. It is the ending that asks the least and promises the same.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The conduit rises at the central convergence. The base hold, no more. Stability is the one future that arrives on schedule.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Extinguishment. The remaining held futures are spent to close the Crownfall for good. The sky stops arguing. So does everything that argued through it.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The conduit rises at the western convergence. Hold it firmly. An ending that silences deserves to be watched every tick of the way down.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: Open Evolution. The Crownfall is released to continue becoming, unmanaged, with everything that implies and nothing that guarantees. We find this one difficult to phrase. That is the point of it.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The conduit rises at the southwestern convergence, and the hold is the longest of the four. What is being released takes its time deciding what it is.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The Resolution Conduit is complete and irreversible. The final hold begins on the next fixed tick. Everything the contract names is now literal.

lines.speaker: Mara Vey
lines.text: All witness stations confirm position. For the record: we stand where we said we would. Hold your line and finish it.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The hold is complete. The contract closed with every protected element standing, and the selected ending is now the recorded one.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Witnessed, all of it, by three factions and seven accounts. What it becomes is tomorrow's argument. What it was is now safely written.

lines.speaker: Talar Venn
lines.text: The register closes on operation fifteen: ending selected, eligibility earned, contract held. The unchosen endings remain unchosen, and the record says so plainly.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The local core is lost. The Crownfall does not renegotiate. The contract fails as written.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: A protected witness is gone. The accord was witnessed or it was nothing; it is now nothing.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The command force is broken. Several voices, no command, and a sky still waiting.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The final contract is breached. It was irreversible; so is this. The attempt records its own failure exactly.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The engagement is terminal. The Crownfall keeps its argument for whoever comes next.

lines.speaker: Neme
lines.text: The operation has failed. No ending was committed; the campaign record stands where it stood.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Something is missing from the record, and the record knows it. A shard, unburied by nobody, waiting on a road we stopped walking.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The founding decision picked our road for us. My accounts have opinions about all three. Today we only get to test one.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Waystone first, at the roadhead. A road without an anchor is a rumor with a direction.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The vaults under this ground are older than my oldest account, and she claims to remember the sun before it broke. Walk carefully.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Roadhead is anchored. The Waystone took to the ground like it remembered it. Perhaps it does.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Now the Listening Spine. Before we take anything from this road, we owe it the courtesy of hearing what it holds.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Spine is up and listening. The strata carry more voices than my seven, and none of them agree either. Reassuring, in its way.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Bearer forward, to the shard site. Slow steps. What was left unburied this long can wait a few minutes more for care.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The bearer holds the shard. The road gave up what it kept, and the record has one gap fewer.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: One shard recovered does not settle what the Assembly argues about. It gives the argument better material. That is the most memory ever does.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: Mark the road open in the accounts. Eighth account, first entry: the way is walkable, and we walked it.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The command core is gone. A road with no authority behind it closes on its own.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The memory bearer is lost. The shard stays where it lay, and the gap in the record keeps its shape.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The Waystone is destroyed. The roadhead is an anchor no longer; the road is a rumor again.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The engagement has gone terminal. Whatever the road holds, it keeps it today.

lines.speaker: Oruun-of-Seven-Stones
lines.text: The operation has failed. We withdraw, and the road stays unburied and unwalked.
